content.short: We provide you with permissionless DeFi tools for a secure and effortless trading experience. 100% open sourced.
content.description:
Our mission is to unlock cross-chain trading for anyone without sacrificing decentralization.

Layer 1 DEX allows you to trade Cardano native assets and provide liquidity to a broad number of pools. With the permissionless design of Spectrum liquidity pools, you can even start executing DEX orders earn fees.

We also build a cross-chain solution called Spectrum Network, that allows other developers to build natively cross-chain dApp on top.
